name: Initiative
description: At the start of combat, each participant makes a Dexterity check to determine turn order.

name: Combat Round
description: A round represents about 6 seconds; each combatant takes a turn in initiative order.

name: Attack Roll
description: Roll a d20 and add relevant modifiers. An attack hits if the total meets or exceeds the target Armor Class.

name: Critical Hit
description: A natural 20 on an attack roll hits and doubles the number of damage dice rolled for the attack.

name: Natural 1 on Attack
description: A natural 1 on an attack roll misses regardless of modifiers.

name: Opportunity Attack
description: Use your reaction to make one melee attack against a creature you can see when it moves out of your reach, unless it Disengages or another exception applies.

name: Cover
description: Half cover grants +2 AC and Dexterity saving throws; three-quarters cover grants +5; total cover prevents direct targeting by attacks or spells.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When you take the Attack action and attack with a light melee weapon in one hand, you can use a bonus action to attack with a different light melee weapon in the other hand. You do not add your ability modifier to bonus attack damage unless negative.

name: Grappling
description: Replace one attack with a special melee attack; make a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the target Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics). A grappled creature has speed 0.

name: Shoving
description: Replace one attack to knock a creature prone or push it 5 feet, using a contested Strength (Athletics) check.

name: Flanking
description: Optional tactical-positioning rule described in the 2014 Dungeon Master’s Guide. Consult a legally owned source for exact mechanics.
